integrity: Proof establishes each quantifier, construction, extremal estimate and asymptotic; standalone standard-library executable tests exact small instances. No independence claimed.
scientific_limitations: An all-length bound with a gap of at most two symbols, not an exact value for every k; residual priority risk of an unindexed fixed-weight-two theorem. Finite computations support but do not replace the proof.
title: A two-unit envelope and sharp square-root overhead for binary weight-two subsequence covers
